title: Rehang a bifold closet door that popped off its floor bracket: lift it on its spring top pivot, drop the pin in plumb
instruction: The bifold closet door has popped off its floor bracket. Put it back so it hangs plumb.
context: Bifold closet doors often pop out of their floor brackets. The bottom pin only goes back if the whole door is lifted a few millimetres against its spring-loaded top pivot, carried back and lowered into the bracket's slot directly under the top pivot; dropped anywhere else along the slot the door hangs out of plumb and rubs the jamb.
setup: Robot: two i2rt YAM Ultra (v2) arms with parallel grippers, each finger limited to 40 N. Coordinates: x forward from the arm bases, y to the left, z up from the table top, which stands in for the floor (z 0). Closet front wall (fixed, painted drywall on studs): room face at x 52.0 cm, 11.6 cm thick, 2.40 m tall, from y +12.0 cm to +65 cm and from y -48.96 cm to -65 cm, with a header above the opening; finished opening 61.0 x 205.1 cm (24 x 80-3/4 in) between the left (pivot) jamb face at y +12.0 cm and the right jamb face at y -48.96 cm; white casing 6.4 cm wide and baseboard 9 cm high on the room face. Inside: back wall at x 90 cm (the closet is shallower than a real one). Track: 1 x 1 in aluminium channel under the head jamb, centre line at x 55.65 cm, bottom at z 202.6 cm, from jamb to jamb, with the steel top pivot bracket at y +8.19 cm. Jamb bracket (steel, fixed): floor plate 3.2 x 9.0 x 0.2 cm at x 54.05-57.25 cm, y +3.0 to +12.0 cm, with a 1.0 cm slot along y (y +3.8 to +10.8 cm, centred on x 55.65 cm), toothed rails 0.4 cm wide and 0.3 cm tall along both edges of the slot (tops 0.5 cm above the floor, teeth at 3 mm pitch), an upturned 3.2 cm leg on the jamb, and a painted mark at y +8.19 cm, directly under the top pivot. Door: a 24 x 80 in louvred pine bifold pair (primed white, full louvres between 5.7 cm stiles; ReliaBilt, listed 15.2 lb), two panels each 29.8 cm wide, 200.0 cm tall and 3.5 cm thick, hinged together with two steel hinges on their closet faces (3 mm gap), 3.45 kg each (6.90 kg the pair). The pivot panel carries a spring-loaded top pivot pin in the top bracket and, 3.2 cm from its jamb edge on its bottom, a bottom pivot bolt: a 2.2 cm toothed nylon wheel 0.3 cm thick and an 8 mm steel pin protruding 4 mm below it (seated, the wheel stands on the rails, the door's bottom is 1.59 cm above the floor and its top 0.95 cm below the track). The lead panel carries a 1.6 cm nylon guide in the track, 3.2 cm from its free edge, and a 3.2 cm brass knob 91 cm (36 in) above its bottom edge. Start: the door is folded open into the room, the pivot panel turned 85 degrees from closed and the lead panel folded back against it (166.5 degrees, guide in the track), their shared hinged edge toward the arms. Its bottom has popped out of the bracket: the pin's tip stands on the floor at x 50.15 cm, y +6.89 cm (5.5 cm toward the room and 1.3 cm away from the jamb from the mark), the door tilted about its top pivot. Distractors, ignored by scoring: folded microfiber towel 20.5 x 21.2 x 3.4 cm, 0.12 kg, centre at (24, -45) cm; cardboard storage box 34.5 x 26.4 x 16.6 cm, 1.2 kg, inside the closet at (75, -30) cm, turned 90 degrees; plastic pedal waste bin 23.8 x 18.0 x 28.0 cm, 1.3 kg, at (38, 52) cm.
scoring: Read every step from the bottom pin's position. Seated: pin centre within 1.5 mm of the slot's centre line across the slot, inside the slot's length, and its tip at most 2.5 mm above the floor (the wheel down on the rails; seated it reads 1 mm). Plumb: pin centre within 4 mm along the slot of the mark under the top pivot. Over the slot: pin centre within 6 mm of the slot's centre line and inside its length. 1.0: seated and plumb, both panels still (under 5 mm/s at the top pivot and under 0.01 rad/s), and every sampled gripper finger point more than 3 cm from both panels, all continuously for 2 s. 0.5: seated, but not 1.0 (off the mark by more than 4 mm, still held or moving). 0.25: over the slot but not seated (resting on the rails' inner edges, or held above the slot). 0: anything else (pin on the floor beside the bracket, or on the plate or a rail more than 6 mm off the slot's centre line). Whatever the end state, 0 if the lead panel's guide ever left the track (more than 14 mm off its centre line). Possible scores: 0, 0.25, 0.5, 1.0.
reset_notes: Lift the door, set the pin's tip on the floor 5.5 cm toward the room and 1.3 cm away from the jamb from the mark (tape mark), with the door folded open 85 degrees and the guide in the track. Nothing is consumed.
fidelity: Door, opening, track and bracket at full size; closet depth shortened. Door pair at its listed 6.90 kg. Arms: i2rt YAM Ultra v2 (i2rt GitHub yam_ultra_v2.yml and model README): standard YAM kinematics (within 5 mm), joint 4 a DM4340 (27 Nm peak), Ultra link masses; fingers 40 N. Spring (300 N/m, 5 N preload) and pin play estimated; teeth a lock along the slot; louvres drawn on solid panels; friction 0.8-0.9.
